headline: Popees Baby Care AGM: All resolutions passed
summary: Popees Baby Care India Ltd shareholders approved all four resolutions at the 38th AGM held on September 30, 2026, including auditor appointment and director re-election.

headline: Loans against FDs surge 43% to ₹2.04 lakh crore
summary: Loans against fixed deposits rose 43% to ₹2.04 lakh crore, with FCNR(B)-linked leverage cited as a key driver of the sharp increase in borrowing activity.

headline: Reliance Industries plans ₹1 lakh crore CBG investment
summary: Reliance Industries plans to invest ₹1 lakh crore in compressed biogas in Andhra Pradesh, with the initiative expected to create 3 lakh jobs in the state.

headline: Sikozy Realtors AGM: Borrowing limit set at ₹5 crore
summary: Sikozy Realtors shareholders approved a borrowing limit of ₹5 crore and adopted FY26 financials despite auditor's going concern warning.

headline: Drug panel rejects national cap on wholesale licences
summary: A drug panel has rejected the idea of a national cap on wholesale licences, instead calling for stricter monitoring at the state level to regulate drug distribution.

headline: Industries seek GST relief on input tax credit
summary: Pharma, EV, and other industries are seeking GST relief to unlock accumulated input tax credit, according to a newspaper report.

headline: SBI Research flags possible 25 bps repo rate hike
summary: SBI Research has flagged the possibility of the Reserve Bank of India raising the repo rate by 25 bps at the October Monetary Policy Committee meeting.

headline: MIAL plans to cut 265 weekly flight slots from Oct 26
summary: Mumbai International Airport plans to temporarily discontinue 265 weekly flight slots from October 26 as part of preparations for the redevelopment of Terminal 1.

headline: Indian coffee exports rise 25% to 2.42 lakh tonne in H1FY27
summary: India's coffee exports rose 25% to 2.42 lakh tonne in H1FY27, driven by strong global demand, benefiting exporters including CCL Products and Tata Consumer Products.

headline: Maharashtra FDA cancels Cipla unit's drug sale licence
summary: Maharashtra FDA has cancelled the drug sale licence of a Cipla unit over alleged violations, as reported by a newspaper. The development raises regulatory concerns for the pharma major.

headline: Jyothy Labs pauses acquisitions, eyes personal care
summary: Jyothy Laboratories has put acquisitions on hold and is shifting focus toward new product launches and the personal care segment, according to a newspaper report.

headline: 7Seas Entertainment AGM voting results submitted
summary: 7Seas Entertainment Ltd filed scrutinizer and e-voting results for its 35th AGM held on September 30, 2026. All ordinary resolutions passed with requisite majority.

headline: Bajaj Housing Finance Q2FY27 AUM up 25% to ₹1.58 lakh crore
summary: Bajaj Housing Finance reported 25% YoY growth in Assets Under Management to ₹1,58,190 crore in Q2FY27. Gross disbursements rose to ₹19,930 crore from ₹15,914 crore a year ago.

headline: Bajaj Finance Q2FY27: AUM up 26.5% to ₹5.84 lakh crore
summary: Bajaj Finance reported Q2FY27 operational metrics with AUM rising 26.5% YoY to ₹584,750 crore. Customer franchise expanded to 128.85 million, while new loans grew 11%.

headline: United Polyfab AGM passes all 9 resolutions
summary: United Polyfab Gujarat Ltd shareholders approved all nine resolutions at the AGM held on September 29, 2026. Key approvals included Gagan Mittal's appointment as CMD and material related party transactions.

headline: MOIL reports 19% YoY rise in Sept sales
summary: MOIL Limited recorded provisional manganese ore sales of 1.64 lakh MT in September 2026, up 15.5% YoY. Cumulative FY27 sales reached 7.78 lakh MT against a target of 25.85 lakh MT.

headline: Megamont approves all AGM resolutions
summary: Megamont Limited approved all three ordinary resolutions at its 36th AGM, including the adoption of FY26 financials and reappointment of director Minal Gaurav Patil.

headline: Viceroy Hotels lends ₹38.45 crore to subsidiary
summary: Viceroy Hotels Limited entered a loan agreement with wholly owned subsidiary SLN Terminus Hotels for ₹38.45 crore at 8.75% p.a. to repay borrowings.

headline: Rex Sealing AGM: Directors reappointed, financials adopted
summary: Rex Sealing & Packing Industries Ltd concluded its 21st AGM on September 30, 2026. Shareholders adopted FY26 financial statements and reappointed Mrs. Meeta Manjunath Nayak as director.

headline: Shreenath Paper takes 75% stake in subsidiary
summary: Shreenath Paper Products Limited has increased its stake in Shreenath Paper Industries Private Limited to 75%, making it a subsidiary effective September 24, 2026.

headline: RNIT AI appoints Patcha & Associates as internal auditors
summary: RNIT AI Solutions Limited appointed M/s. Patcha & Associates as internal auditors for FY27 following board approval on October 3, 2026.

headline: RBI Governor flags high cost of financial complacency
summary: RBI Governor stated no immediate financial sector risks are visible but cautioned that complacency carries a high economic cost, signalling the need for sustained vigilance.

headline: RBI Governor flags risks of prolonged financial stability
summary: RBI Governor cautioned that banking risks can develop quickly and that prolonged financial stability may reduce vigilance among institutions and regulators.

headline: Himalaya Nutravedics FY26 PAT jumps 231% to ₹739 lakh
summary: Himalaya Nutravedics India Limited reported a 231.1% surge in FY26 PAT to ₹739.0 lakh. Revenue doubled to ₹4,306.8 lakh as own-brand sales hit 51% of total revenue.

headline: Texmaco Rail wins ₹3.65 crore anti-bird disc order
summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹3.65 crore order from West Central Railway for an anti-bird disc project, with completion expected within one year.

headline: Neo Infracon CS Sonalben Kanabar resigns
summary: Neo Infracon Limited announced the resignation of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Sonalben Kanabar. She will serve until October 31, 2026, citing personal reasons.

headline: RBI Governor: India leads global GDP growth
summary: RBI Governor stated that India has the strongest GDP growth globally, even amid the ongoing conflict in West Asia, highlighting the economy's resilience.

headline: Sedemac Q2FY27 ECU Sales Jump 37.5%
summary: Sedemac Mechatronics reports record quarterly sales of control-intensive ECUs, rising 37.5% YoY to 1.45 million units in Q2FY27.

headline: Garware Hi-Tech to host investor meet in Singapore
summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films will hold one-on-one meetings with institutional investors in Singapore from October 7-9, 2026, hosted by Motilal Oswal.

headline: DMart Q2FY27 revenue up 18% to ₹19,206 crore
summary: Avenue Supermarts reported standalone revenue of ₹19,206.18 crore for Q2FY27, marking an 18.4% YoY growth. The retailer expanded its network to 518 stores as of September 30, 2026.
